bio: Cats and cake, what more could be desired? Enjoy a traditional afternoon tea for two with bottomless Prosecco in London’s latest cat cafe.  Whiskers and Cream in Upper Holloway has established the paw-some trend that has already taken the rest of the world by storm. Tuck into an array of tempting sandwiches, delicious sweet treats and warm scones with jam and clotted cream. These indulgent delights will be topped off with bottomless prosecco and unlimited tea and coffee.  Pet and play with the cafe’s furry cat residents as you relax in this elegant and stylish venue. This afternoon treat is bound to leave you feeling like the cat that got the cream!
